question: Under the unchanged R6-R9 deterministic independent sampler streams and exact phase-anchored support observable, is the first integer per-surface observation budget with complete nine-entity alias restoration 108, or does restoration first occur at 105, 106, or 107?
hypothesis: R9's monotone one-class reduction at each four-observation step from 96 through 108 reflects the last missing same-entity context persisting through budget 107; budgets 105, 106, and 107 will therefore retain at least one split entity triplet, and budget 108 will be the first fully restored arm.

prior_evidence.observation: Nested budgets 96, 100, 104, 108, and 112 produced respectively 12, 11, 10, 9, and 9 alias classes and 3, 2, 1, 0, and 0 split entity triplets. Budget 104 retained one split triplet; budget 108 was fully restored; counts were nonincreasing with zero collisions and no restoration reversal.

scope_statement: This experiment changes exactly one R9 dimension: it fills the three unobserved integer budgets between the frozen 104 and 108 endpoints. Streams, motifs, contexts, phase coordinate, seeds, representation, induction, capacity, and evaluator-only audit remain unchanged. It does not search seeds, add approximate matching, train a task model, or claim language competence.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.budget104_replication_control: The first 104 observations from every frozen R6 independent entity/family stream; must exactly reproduce the R9 budget-104 arm.
arms_and_inputs.budget105_arm: The first 105 observations from every same frozen stream.
arms_and_inputs.budget106_arm: The first 106 observations from every same frozen stream.
arms_and_inputs.budget107_arm: The first 107 observations from every same frozen stream.
arms_and_inputs.budget108_replication_control: The first 108 observations from every same frozen stream; must exactly reproduce the R9 budget-108 arm.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Deterministic support/class cardinality and evaluator-only entity-membership audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: The exact R6-R9 independent seed formula; every lower-budget arm is an exact prefix of the 108 arm. No new, searched, or adaptively selected seed is introduced.

representation_and_measurement.surface_selection: The same twenty-seven raw four-byte motifs selected from the frozen R2 matched bridge, occurrence count descending then lexicographic raw key.
representation_and_measurement.signature: Complete sorted set of observed five-byte anchored context tuples; count magnitudes are discarded and equality is exact.
representation_and_measurement.identifiability_audit: For each arm, count induced classes, three-member classes, correct same-entity alias triplets, split entity triplets, and unordered distinct-entity pairs whose surfaces share a class.
representation_and_measurement.onset_measure: The smallest fully restored member of [105,106,107,108], where full restoration means exactly nine classes, nine correct three-member triplets, zero split triplets, and zero cross-entity collisions.
representation_and_measurement.semantic_scoring: Entity and family identity enter only after class induction for the audit.

controls: The 104-observation R9 replication must reproduce 2808 records, 10 classes, 8 correct alias triplets, 1 split entity triplet, and zero cross-entity collision pairs.
The 108-observation R9 replication must reproduce 2916 records, 9 classes, 9 correct alias triplets, 0 split entity triplets, and zero cross-entity collision pairs.
All five arms are nested prefixes of the exact same frozen streams; only prefix length changes.
All arms use identical selected motifs, context formulas, phase coordinate, exact-support representation, class inducer, and evaluator.
Class induction receives no family label, entity label, semantic label, alias dictionary, tokenizer, task transition, external model, approximate matching, distance threshold, or oracle correction.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R9 probe reproduces both frozen 104 and 108 endpoint controls before any R10 scientific output is emitted.
All lower-budget streams exactly match prefixes of the 108-observation streams.
Every surface has exactly its frozen number of records; every context index and byte construction is in range.
Entity and family identity are unavailable to induction and enter only the post-induction audit; all 36 unordered entity pairs are audited exactly once per arm.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, threshold change, seed search, adaptive budget selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.exact_onset_108_supported: Validity and controls pass; budgets 105, 106, and 107 each retain at least one split entity triplet or more than nine classes, budget 108 is fully restored, all monotonicity conditions pass, and first_restored_budget equals 108.
classification_rules.earlier_onset_observed: Validity and controls pass; at least one of budgets 105, 106, or 107 is fully restored, first_restored_budget is the smallest restored budget, and all monotonicity conditions pass.
classification_rules.budget_response_falsified: Validity and controls pass, but class count or split-triplet count increases with budget, or a fully restored arm is followed by a non-restored arm.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass, but results satisfy none of the preceding scientific rules.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Either the 104 or 108 R9 endpoint replication fails any frozen exact threshold.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents all five frozen arms.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, nested-prefix, sampling, representation, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, R9 endpoint replication, construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R10 output begins, complete all five arms and all frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not add budgets, inspect alternate seeds, or alter sampling, representation, controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacity, or classification after observing R10 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R10 output.
